newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ericsson still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ericsson still a buy.

text.p: -- Banco Fator SA said it was maintaining its buy rating on shares of Ericsson Telecomunicacoes, a unit of Sweden's Ericsson AB.
-- Fator said in a report it raised its year-end target price on the Brazilian stock to 49.23 reais from 36.67 reais.

-- The bank said the increase in its target price reflected a 121.4 percent rise in the company's portfolio of orders as of the end of 1996 and Ericsson's "good prospects for growth as a result of investments in the telecommunications sector."
-- "The company closed out 1996 with a portfolio of orders of $1.169 billion compared with $528 million in 1995 and $242 million in 1994," Fator said.
-- The figure was slightly higher than Fator's forecast of between $1.0 billion and $1.1 billion, the bank said.

-- The Brazilian Communications Ministry projects investments in the sector will reach 62 billion reais by 2003, combined with expected investments in the soon-to-be-privatized cellular B Band, it said.
-- Ericsson is one of the world's largest cellular equipment suppliers.
-- Ericsson preferred stock was up 2.37 percent at 38.90 reais while its common stock was up 0.85 percent at 35.40 reais at 1651 local (1951 GMT) on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
